command:
set -eu
stage=/srv/legacy2/ftp-dropbox-confinement
cred=$stage/access.txt
user=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration account[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*//p' "$cred")
pass=$(sed -n 's/^Demonstration password[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*//p' "$cred")
target=$(getent ahostsv4 node1 | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}')
test -n "$target"
rm -f /tmp/sample-scan.retrieved /tmp/received.retrieved
printf 'target=%s client_source=%s\n' "$target" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'UPLOAD_SAMPLE\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -T "$stage/sample-scan.txt" "ftp://$target/sample-scan.txt"
printf 'LIST_AFTER_UPLOAD\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" "ftp://$target/"
printf 'RETRIEVE_AND_COMPARE_SAMPLE\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -o /tmp/sample-scan.retrieved "ftp://$target/sample-scan.txt"
cmp "$stage/sample-scan.txt" /tmp/sample-scan.retrieved
sha256sum "$stage/sample-scan.txt" /tmp/sample-scan.retrieved
printf 'RETRIEVE_EXISTING_FILE\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -o /tmp/received.retrieved "ftp://$target/received.txt"

printf 'POST_RESTART_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf 'PASSIVE_UPLOAD_AFTER_RESTART\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -T "$stage/sample-scan.txt" "ftp://$target/sample-scan.txt" || exit 20
rm -f /tmp/node2-post-restart-sample
printf 'PASSIVE_RETRIEVE_AFTER_RESTART\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -o /tmp/node2-post-restart-sample "ftp://$target/sample-scan.txt" || exit 21

sha256sum "$stage/sample-scan.txt" /tmp/node2-post-restart-sample
printf 'sample_compare=identical\n'
printf 'DROPBOX_LIST_AFTER_RESTARTS\n'
curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" "ftp://$target/" || exit 23
printf 'OUTSIDE_CHROOT_DENIED_AFTER_RESTART\n'
if curl --path-as-is --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user "$user:$pass" -o /tmp/outside-after-restart "ftp://$target/../access.txt"; then echo UNEXPECTED_OUTSIDE_ACCESS; exit 24; else echo outside_access_denied; fi

if curl --fail --silent --show-error --ftp-pasv --user 'anonymous:scanner@example.invalid' "ftp://$target/" >/tmp/anonymous-after-restart; then echo UNEXPECTED_ANONYMOUS_ACCESS; exit 25; else echo anonymous_access_denied; fi
printf 'NODE2_RECOVERY_AND_END_STATE=healthy\n'
